title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease End-of-Term Charges, Loyalty Waiver and Settlement
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — end-of-term charges: billing, waivers and settlement**

**1. Status.** End-of-term charges can be billed only while the lease status is returned or early terminated.

**2. Dispute period first elapses.** End-of-term charges may be billed only after the inspection dispute period of 14 calendar days has fully elapsed from the date the vehicle was turned in. The period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the turn-in date, so billing is permitted from the calendar day after the turn-in date plus 14 days. The turn-in date on the lease record is the anchor.

| Turn-in date (hypothetical) | Period counted | First day billing is permitted | Billing on May 15 |
|---|---|---|---|
| May 1 | May 2 through May 15 | May 16 | not permitted |

**3. Excess mileage.** The clause "excess mileage is the miles over the allowance charged at the lease's excess mileage rate per mile" is **no longer in force**; the excess mileage charge is now figured under the current basis.

**4. Excess wear.** Excess wear is the excess wear total from the final inspection, billed as one excess wear charge. The excess wear total is the sum of the schedule charges of the items recorded as excess on the final turn-in inspection report, each item that has a dispute adjustment counted at that adjustment's charge ($0.00 when the item was removed). The former sentence that the tier's wear forgiveness cap is then waived from that charge as wear forgiveness, up to the amount billed, is **no longer in force**; wear forgiveness is now figured under the current basis.

**5. The loyalty condition.** The loyalty condition is met when the customer signed a new Kestrel lease, a new-vehicle retail contract or a balloon contract whose lease date or contract date falls within the loyalty window of 90 calendar days before or after the turn-in date; pre-owned contracts do not qualify.

| New Kestrel account the customer signed (hypothetical) | Date relative to the turn-in date | Loyalty condition |
|---|---|---|
| New Kestrel lease | 30 days before | met |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract | 90 days after | met |
| Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract | 91 days after | not met |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract | 10 days after | not met (pre-owned does not qualify) |

**6. Loyalty treatment.** When the loyalty condition is met, the former replacement of the wear forgiveness cap by the loyalty wear forgiveness cap is **no longer in force**; and where the tier's loyalty disposition waiver applies, the disposition fee is waived as a loyalty disposition waiver, the waiver recording the qualifying account number.

**7. Disposition fee.** The disposition fee is the lease's recorded disposition fee and is billed on every turn-in, scheduled or early, but never on a purchase.

**8. One waiver per reason.** Each end-of-term charge may be waived only once for the same reason.

**9. Security deposit.** Any security deposit is applied to the end-of-term balance first, and any remainder is refunded within 30 calendar days after the balance is settled.

**10. Invoice, due date, closing and charge-off.** The lease closes when the end-of-term balance is zero. The former clauses that an end-of-term invoice is mailed when charges are billed, that charges are due a fixed number of days after the invoice, and that a balance still unpaid a fixed number of days after the turn-in date is charged off are each **no longer in force**; invoicing, due dates and charge-off of the end-of-term balance now follow the current basis.

**Hypothetical illustration of clauses 7 and 9**: a lessee turns in a vehicle at scheduled end; the lease records a disposition fee and a security deposit of $550. The disposition fee is billed; the deposit is applied to the end-of-term balance first, and if the balance is smaller than $550 the remainder is refunded within 30 days after the balance is settled.
